service.description: Executes a single pipeline compute step. If pipelineStepId is passed, fulfills that existing draft step in-place; otherwise creates a new step. Records status as PlsExecuting, triggers the AI agent dispatch, writes the output into AgiPayload, and updates egressPayloadId upon completion.

Creates an unexecuted draft step branching off or succeeding an existing step. Supports advancing from Plan -> Build with targetStanceEnumId. If sourceStepId is omitted, attaches to the latest step or initializes the root step of the discussion. egressPayloadId is explicitly left null.
Recursively flags an AgiPipelineStep and all downstream descendant steps as PlsArchived.

actions.script:
ec.logger.info("📦 [archive#PipelineBranch] Archiving branch starting from step #${pipelineStepId}...") int count = 0
def archiveStepRecursive archiveStepRecursive = { String stepId -> def step = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.pipeline.AgiPipelineStep") .condition("pipelineStepId", stepId) .one() if (step && step.statusId != "PlsArchived") { step.statusId = "PlsArchived" step.lastUpdatedDate = ec.user.nowTimestamp step.update() count++
def children = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.pipeline.AgiPipelineStep") .condition("parentStepId", stepId) .list() children.each { child -> archiveStepRecursive(child.pipelineStepId as String) } } }
archiveStepRecursive(pipelineStepId) context.archivedCount = count ec.logger.info("📦 [archive#PipelineBranch] Completed archival of ${count} step(s).")

service.description: Decomposes an approved module scope into individual draft PLAN steps. Iterates through a list of sub-modules/sub-screens and forks a downstream draft step for each, anchored to the parent discussion step.
Extracts a pipeline step (and optionally its downstream branch) from its current pipeline and promotes it into a new standalone AgiDiscussion.
